title: Aura-to-Medication Turnaround
dataSources: Allergy symptoms (`allergy:entry`), migraine records (`migraine:entry`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), and sleep-talking events (`sleeptalk:event`).
app: Symptom telemetry for allergy diaries, migraine aura tracking, bathroom frequency logging, and sleep-talking review sent to Splunk HEC via apps and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=migraine:entry
| search medication_delay_min=*
| stats avg(medication_delay_min) as avg_medication_delay_min perc90(medication_delay_min) as p90_medication_delay_min count as samples by medication_name
| sort 0 - avg_medication_delay_min
value: Turnaround from aura to medication is a practical measure of how usable your rescue plan really is.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for aura-to-medication turnaround to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 aura-to-medication turnaround.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how long aura-to-medication turnaround usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
